name: EZ Horoscope
author: EZHoroscope

sections.description:
EZ Horoscope is the Astrology platform for WordPress.

Our core platform is free and has everything you need to display beautiful and engaging horoscopes for each of the zodiac signs.

  • Create Stunning, Engaging Horoscopes (https://www.enneagramzoom.com/horoscope/aries-horoscope-today/) for each of the 12 zodiac signs, keeping your readers intrigued and eager for more.
  • Boost Traffic and Ad Revenue with irresistible daily content that drives clicks and encourages return visits.
  • Daily Fresh Insights Our horoscopes are crafted every day with new guidance, advice, and planetary influences, ensuring your content stays relevant and captivating.
  • NASA-Backed Cosmic Precision We calculate cosmic influences daily using NASA’s astronomical ephemeris, providing the most accurate astrological guidance.
  • Track Every Retrograde Stay ahead of every planetary retrograde, with clear explanations of how each retrograde affects your zodiac sign’s unique path.
  • Detailed Planetary Aspects Including trines, oppositions, and more—every aspect is interpreted and delivered for each zodiac sign’s horoscope.
  • Lunar Phases and Folklore Learn how each phase of the moon and its folklore affects your readers, creating a deeper connection to the universe.
  • Influences of 15 Fixed Stars From Sirius to Regulus, our plugin tracks and interprets the daily conjunctions between these stars and the planets, adding depth to your horoscopes.
  • Effortless Setup Up and running in minutes with a simple shortcode—no coding required. Start offering daily horoscopes that keep your audience coming back!
  • Customizable Design Tailor the look of your horoscopes to match your website’s unique style. Adjust background colors, fonts, and sizes to create a seamless experience that fits perfectly with your theme.
  • Premium Features Available Upgrade to the premium version to unlock advanced features, including individual horoscope components for greater customization of the look and feel of your horoscopes, as well as the ability to disable affiliate promotions, links, and call-to-actions.

Privacy Notice

By activating this plugin, you agree to share the following data with us:
– The URL of the website where the plugin is activated.
– The date and time of plugin activation.
This data is used solely for tracking plugin activations and improving our services. We do not collect any personal user information.

For more information, please see our privacy policy at:
https://www.enneagramzoom.com/Home/Privacy

Affiliate Disclosure

Some horoscope content generated by this plugin may include affiliate links and promotions. This means that if users click on a link and make a purchase, we may earn a commission at no extra cost to you. This helps support the continuous development of the plugin and keeps the content free for users. These links and promotions can be disabled in the Professional Version.
sections.installation:
Follow these simple steps to download, install, and activate the EZ Horoscope Plugin on your WordPress site:

Install the Plugin via the WordPress Repository

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard (https://yoursite.com/wp-admin).
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Search for “EZ Horoscope Plugin.”
  4. Click Install Now, and then click Activate.

To display horoscopes, use the shortcode [ezhp_ezhoroscope sign=”zodiac_sign”] in your posts or pages.
Replace “zodiac_sign” with the desired zodiac sign (e.g., [ezhp_ezhoroscope sign=”aquarius”]).
Preview Your Site

Visit the page or post where the shortcode was added to view the daily horoscope.
sections.faq:
How do I display a horoscope for a specific zodiac sign?

Use the shortcode [ezhp_ezhoroscope sign="zodiac_sign"] in any post or page. Replace zodiac_sign with one of the following:
– aries
– taurus
– gemini
– cancer
– leo
– virgo
– libra
– scorpio
– sagittarius
– capricorn
– aquarius
– pisces

Example: [ezhp_ezhoroscope sign="leo"] displays the daily horoscope for Leo.

How often is the horoscope content updated?

The horoscope content is updated daily, ensuring fresh horoscopes are always displayed.

Is the plugin mobile responsive?

Yes, the iframe containing the horoscope content adjusts to fit mobile and desktop screens.
